title: 1959 Chevrolet Bel Air vs. 2009 Chevrolet Malibu IIHS crash test
summary: A one-minute IIHS demonstration crash test of a 1959 Chevrolet Bel Air against a 2009 Chevrolet Malibu, showing how much better the modern car protects its occupants.
why: The go-to demonstration in car-safety debates that old cars were not better, showing crumple zones and a rigid passenger cell at work.

quote.text: I always liked this IIHS crash test: 1959 Chevrolet Bel Air vs. 2009 Chevrolet Malibu It really shows the progress.
